label: Bare cultivated alley (current)
main_benefit: No water competition with vines; familiar management
main_risk: Winter-storm erosion on bare ground; no N or organic-matter input; hot bare surface
key_assumption: Tillage keeps alley bare year-round (3-5 passes/yr)

label: Permanent resident grass
main_benefit: Strong erosion control; organic matter; cooler alley surface
main_risk: Season-long water competition with vines on shallow soil in dry summers
key_assumption: Cover kept year-round; mown 2-4 times/yr; no irrigation assumed

label: Winter legume then summer mulch
main_benefit: Winter erosion control + free nitrogen; avoids summer water competition
main_risk: Establishment cost; late termination in wet springs still costs water; N range uncertain
key_assumption: Subterranean clover/medic self-reseeds; terminated ~15 May or natural summer die-back
